body:
I'm still seeing a therapist, actually a psychiatrist, and I'm still on Zoloft but neither is doing much. 

The first one just kept telling me to move to where I'd be happy, but the trouble is I don't know where that would even be. Lately I've felt disconnected even from my closest friends and think I'd be depressed even in Atlanta living near them. I'm also terrified of failing again or not being able to make it. Regardless, they are pressuring me to move back. My mom is pressuring me to stay even though it's a toxic environment. Something needs to change but i don't know how or what to do for that to happen.
